# Report 6 tables (generated by results/exp6/report6.py)

Ensemble = mean of the logits of model seeds 0, 1, 2; flip if > 0 (rule fixed in advance). Single seeds are the ensemble members from the same run. Adaptive members each keep their own fingerprint buffer (live) or all get the frozen nominal fingerprint (frozen). Update every 200 shots. Streams pooled over stream seeds 0,1,2,3,4. McNemar exact, two-sided; p in 0.001–0.05 = weak evidence; no multiple-testing correction. The best WindowDEM is picked per phase after the fact.
